classes.name: QuantExpr
classes.description: Quant Expression — 对单个收益率序列或 alpha 预测值进行量化操作。所有方法作用于一个 expression 对象。

methods.name: nav
methods.description: 从收益率序列计算累计净值序列

methods.name: total_return
methods.description: 从收益率序列计算区间总收益率

methods.name: annualized_return
methods.description: 从收益率序列计算年化收益率

methods.name: annualized_volatility
methods.description: 从收益率序列计算年化波动率

methods.name: daily_win_ratio
methods.description: 计算日频胜率

methods.name: active_return
methods.description: 给定收益率相对于基准收益率的超额收益率

methods.name: annualized_active_return
methods.description: 计算相对基准的年化超额收益率

methods.name: total_active_return
methods.description: 计算相对基准的区间总超额收益率

methods.name: drawdown
methods.description: 从收益率序列计算回撤序列

methods.name: max_drawdown
methods.description: 计算最大回撤

methods.name: max_underwater
methods.description: 计算最长连续水下期数

methods.name: underwater
methods.description: 从收益率序列计算连续水下天数序列

methods.name: sharpe
methods.description: 从收益率序列计算年化 Sharpe 比率

methods.name: sortino
methods.description: 从收益率序列计算年化 Sortino 比率

methods.name: rolling_sharpe
methods.description: 计算固定窗口滚动 Sharpe 比率

methods.name: return_to_drawdown
methods.description: 计算年化收益与绝对最大回撤之比

methods.name: day_cumrtn_corr
methods.description: 计算日序号与累计净值之间的相关系数——衡量净值增长稳定性

methods.name: ols
methods.description: 做 OLS 回归

methods.name: ols_residuals
methods.description: 做 OLS 回归取残差

methods.name: ridge
methods.description: 做 ridge 回归

methods.name: lasso
methods.description: 做 lasso 回归

methods.name: zscore
methods.description: 求 z-score 标准化

methods.name: standardize
methods.description: 标准化

methods.name: normalization
methods.description: 做归一化

methods.name: winsorize
methods.description: 做 winsorization 缩尾处理

methods.name: sigmoid
methods.description: 求 sigmoid 变换

methods.name: demean
methods.description: 求去均值

methods.name: demedian
methods.description: 求去中位数

methods.name: neutralize
methods.description: 做中性化处理

methods.name: optimize
methods.description: 通过优化器将 alpha 预测值变换为仓位权重

methods.name: clean
methods.description: 清洗脏数据（去除 NaN/Inf 等）

methods.name: average_turnover
methods.description: 计算平均日换手

methods.name: weekly_average_turnover
methods.description: 计算每周汇总换手后的平均值

methods.name: average_turnover_by_calendar_day
methods.description: 计算按自然日摊薄后的平均换手

methods.name: turnover_efficiency
methods.description: 计算换手效率指标

methods.name: profit_per_turnover
methods.description: 计算单位总换手对应的总收益

methods.name: monthly_max_drawdown
methods.description: 计算月频收益序列的最大回撤

methods.name: monthly_win_ratio
methods.description: 按月聚合后计算月胜率

methods.name: weekly_max_drawdown
methods.description: 计算周频收益序列的最大回撤

methods.name: weekly_win_ratio
methods.description: 按周聚合后计算周胜率

classes.name: QuantDF
classes.description: Quant DataFrame — 在 DataFrame 级别进行截面/时序/滚动操作。底层计算委托给 QuantExpr。

methods.name: cross_sectional
methods.description: 对每个截面应用 QuantExpr 操作——比如对每列 zscore

methods.name: time_series
methods.description: 对每个时间序列应用 QuantExpr 操作——比如对每行做 sharpe

methods.name: rolling
methods.description: 滚动对每个窗口应用操作

methods.name: downsample
methods.description: 将数据降频到指定频率

methods.name: select
methods.description: 选取标准 index 列和指定表达式

methods.name: interval_return
methods.description: 计算区间收益表

methods.name: monthly_return
methods.description: 将日收益率按月聚合为带标签的 dataframe

methods.name: weekly_return
methods.description: 将日收益率按周聚合为带标签的 dataframe

methods.name: monthly_active_return
methods.description: 将日超额收益按月聚合为带标签的 dataframe

methods.name: weekly_active_return
methods.description: 将日超额收益按周聚合为带标签的 dataframe

methods.name: monthly_drawdown
methods.description: 计算月频收益序列对应的回撤表

methods.name: weekly_drawdown
methods.description: 计算周频收益序列对应的回撤表

methods.name: perf_eval_report
methods.description: 生成绩效评估 HTML 报告——综合调用多种 QuantExpr 指标

methods.name: perf_eval_summarize
methods.description: 汇总一个或多个组合收益序列的绩效指标

methods.name: monthly_yearly
methods.description: 生成月度/年度收益透视表

methods.name: monthly_yearly_active
methods.description: 生成月度/年度超额收益透视表

methods.name: optimize
methods.description: 按日期逐期运行组合优化器——会调用 QuantExpr.optimize

methods.name: to_layout
methods.description: 将结果 dataframe 转换为指定布局格式

methods.name: to_terminal
methods.description: 将结果 dataframe 渲染为适合终端阅读的字符串

notes.Standard DataFrame Layout: QuantDF 的标准数据布局——行=日期、列=股票代码、值=alpha/收益
notes.Optimizer: 仓位优化器的配置参数文档
